name: Anhui Huaren Health Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Huaren Health Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates in the medical and healthcare industry. It offers products for oral and throat, nourishing, heat-clearing, respiratory system, and gynecology, as well as provides vitamins and minerals, and detoxifying products. In addition, it provides supplements, and nutrition and health products. Anhui Huaren Health Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Hefei, China.
